PROJECTS.CASE_ORDERCORE_PROBLEM: Simultaneous orders could sell the same stock twice, and a repeated checkout could charge twice.
PROJECTS.CASE_ORDERCORE_DECISION: Stock reservation under concurrency, idempotent checkout, Stripe payments, RabbitMQ messaging and integration tests with Testcontainers.
PROJECTS.CASE_ORDERCORE_RESULT: API with CI on GitHub Actions and concurrency and payment scenarios covered by tests.
PROJECTS.CASE_COURSECORE_PROBLEM: Course platforms need the same core (users, permissions, lessons, progress), rebuilt for every client.
PROJECTS.CASE_COURSECORE_DECISION: Modular white-label backend with JWT, permission control and auditing.
PROJECTS.CASE_COURSECORE_RESULT: Reusable base with automated tests and CI that checks for vulnerable packages.
PROJECTS.CASE_ARCHFLOW_PROBLEM: Teams using Scrum and Kanban end up splitting their work across two tools.
PROJECTS.CASE_ARCHFLOW_DECISION: A single platform, with a .NET 9 backend and DDD, a Next.js front end and JWT in HttpOnly cookies.
PROJECTS.CASE_ARCHFLOW_RESULT: API and interface integrated, with the front end deployed on Vercel.
PROJECTS.CASE_PDV_WEB_PROBLEM: Legacy PHP application, hard to evolve and to integrate with the ERP.
PROJECTS.CASE_PDV_WEB_DECISION: Migration to C#/ASP.NET Core with a Next.js front end, keeping compatibility with the main ERP.
PROJECTS.CASE_PDV_WEB_RESULT: System in production, used by the sales team. Built during my internship.
PROJECTS.CASE_MARFIM_PROBLEM: Validate the OrderCore API with a real client.
PROJECTS.CASE_MARFIM_DECISION: Storefront (catalog, cart, checkout, account) and an admin panel for orders, inventory, payments and auditing.
PROJECTS.CASE_MARFIM_RESULT: Complete e-commerce live, consuming the API.
PROJECTS.CASE_QUANTUM_CRM_PROBLEM: Sales teams lose track of opportunities.
PROJECTS.CASE_QUANTUM_CRM_DECISION: I worked as Product Owner and architect (requirements, DDD architecture and diagrams) and also built the full stack.
PROJECTS.CASE_QUANTUM_CRM_RESULT: Lead management system delivered in the FATEC Jacareí project.
